description: Least-privilege IPC surface for the four local Jarvis windows: the quickbar, the HUD, the desktop widget and the settings window. Every privileged operation the frontend reaches — capture, health, chat streaming, the fanned-out event stream, approvals, clipboard, notifications, widget geometry, backend supervision — goes through app-defined commands in commands.rs, stream.rs and sidecar.rs, which are not permission-gated, so no clipboard-manager, notification, global-shortcut or shell plugin permissions are granted here. There is deliberately no `remote` block: every window loads a bundled page, and no external origin gets IPC at all. The HUD page in particular is vendored from the backend folder and never loaded over the network, so a compromise of the web app cannot reach a Tauri command.
